§5The Omega-Death Scythe, a relic of unfathomable destruction,
forged by the Architect as a shadow of something far greater.
Though merely an echo of Nacker’s true creation,
its power is anything but diminished—each swing carries the weight of oblivion itself,
severing fate and existence in an instant. A weapon forgotten across realities,
its presence alone warps the fabric of creation, leaving only devastation in its wake.

and one of the things I used to make maps/worlds on all the time, I often like to recreate things I find cool but inside minecraft...
And NO, the rainbow has nothing to do with lgbt or whatever,
its solely based on what the ORIGINAL looked like, get out)'
